per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

notes: Off note THE-MAX-PATH-FOLD-RIDES-THE-CHAIN-SURFACE item 2, which asked whether another consumer surface carries the same hole. Measured this drain: 40 keys, 14 named nowhere — `Baton`, four error classes incl. `TipClaimHeldError`, `gitPath`, `isPickableNow`, `matchesAny`, `parsePendingQueueLoose`, `priorAttemptsDir`, `readGatedQueue`, `readLatestVerdictsSync`, `slugify`, `stopFlagPath`. The page-to-surface direction is already pinned. The bar must admit `api.paths`, named only prefixed.
